segments.speaker: Host
segments.body: My guest today studies how rivers rearrange mountains.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.body: Rearrange is right. The river is doing the carving, but the uplift sets the pace.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.body: So the rock is rising while the water is cutting down.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.body: Exactly. Whichever wins that race is what you see from the road.
